# MPXJ 16.10.0

Reads Microsoft Project `.mpp` files for the schedule upload (`src/services/schedule-import.js`).
Java 11+ must be installed on the server (`java` on the PATH, or set `JAVA_BIN`).

Jars taken from the `mpxj` package on PyPI (test-only jars removed). MPXJ is LGPL-2.1; see `licenses/`.
